subject: 明代北方府城：府县衙门（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
footprint_basis: design/22 §3.4 明代对应骨架；本套件地域命名
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Turn this EXACT parallelogram into a thin paved foundation supporting one Ming northern Chinese yamen government courtyard module. Keep the precise existing outer silhouette, composition and footprint at pixel positions left168,570 rear705.9,301 right1368,632.1 front830.1,901 on this1536x1152canvas. The diagonals must stay exactly at+/-0.5 slope. DO NOT lengthen or narrow the shape. This is a16by13metre rectangle in2:1orthographicdimetricprojection. Add finely realistic weatheredgraystone paving entirely INSIDE shape, build upwards within it. Entire three visible base corners remain visible. Central front wooden gate and modest screen wall, greybrick enclosure, rear five-bay grey tiled official hall with darkred columns and subtle Ming beam painting, two small grey hard-gabled side wings, restrained anonymous northern government architecture. Realistic hand-painted RPG map asset, detailed brickwork, tile seams, wooden doors, upper-left natural light. No people, text, signs, watermark, modern items. Background true transparent alpha0. Roof and all foundation corners uncut with margin. Front wall MUST be parallel to template lower-left edge; right wall to template lower-right edge. Footprint geometry must be traced exactly from template.

references.role: 精确几何参考；已view_image；仅供image_gen重建

visual_review: 第2轮逐张view_image两候选，选本轮整体较优图；主体、底角完整，RGBA透明，光源左上。实测斜率与宽深比见repair-r2记录，仍未同时达到审核几何阈值，保留candidate；未做仿射或透视纠偏。
source_point_semantics: 可见薄石基脚L/F/R外缘顶点；取alpha>200下轮廓辅助定位，屋檐、台阶不作占地角
selection_reason: 两候选内优先保留形制与材料，并兼顾斜率和比例；未达标如实登记
negative: 排除项完整内嵌于prompt；工具无独立negative参数。
final_view_image_review: 第2轮已逐张view_image规范化成品：轮廓及底面完整，透明留边，左上光向、纹理密度可读；几何仍有已登记残差，尚不通过严格审核。
